item.title: In the classroom
item.description: Things and words for lessons at school or a language course.

children.definition: a table where you sit to read, write or work
children.example: My book is on the desk.

children.definition: a big flat surface on the wall where the teacher writes
children.example: The teacher writes the new words on the board.

children.definition: a thing you use to write with ink
children.example: Have you got a blue pen?

children.definition: a thin wooden thing for writing or drawing, usually in grey
children.example: I draw pictures with a pencil.

children.definition: a small book with empty pages that you write in
children.example: Write the new words in your notebook.

children.definition: work that a teacher gives you to do at home
a time when a teacher teaches you something
children.example: Our English lesson starts at nine.

children.definition: something you ask when you want to know something
children.example: Can I ask a question, please?

children.definition: what you say or write after someone asks you something
a person in the same class as you
children.example: Aziz is my classmate. We sit together.
Sorry, I don't understand this word.
